key_concepts: Some electrical devices are powered by batteries.
Some electrical devices are powered by plugging into an electrical outlet.
Some electrical devices can use both batteries and electrical outlets.
Electrical devices can be used to cool a room.
Electrical devices can provide hot and cold water.
Electrical devices can be used for entertainment.
Electrical devices can be used for cooking food.
Electrical devices can be used for communication.
Electricity powers appliances to perform specific everyday tasks.
Do not touch electrical equipment with wet hands or feet.
Avoid using electrical devices in the bathroom.
Damaged electrical cords should be repaired by a licensed electrician.
